base_queries.name: txn_summary
base_queries.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'n', average(duration)*1000 AS 'avg_ms', percentile(duration,95)*1000 AS 'p95_ms', max(duration)*1000 AS 'max_ms' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: discover_appnames
base_queries.nrql: SELECT uniques(appName) FROM Transaction SINCE 60 minutes ago LIMIT 50

base_queries.name: throughput
base_queries.nrql: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'req_per_min' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: latency_p95
base_queries.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95_ms' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: top_transactions_p95
base_queries.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95_ms' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: avg_transactions
base_queries.nrql: FROM Transaction SELECT average(duration)*1000 AS 'avg_ms' {{appNameClause}} FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: max_transactions
base_queries.nrql: FROM Transaction SELECT max(duration)*1000 AS 'max_ms' {{appNameClause}} FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: error_count
base_queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'errors' {{appNameClause}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: top_errors
base_queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'count' {{appNameClause}} FACET error.message LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: top_error_classes
base_queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'count' {{appNameClause}} FACET error.class LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: errors_by_endpoint
base_queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'count' {{appNameClause}} FACET transactionName LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: errors_by_endpoint_uri
base_queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'count' {{appNameClause}} FACET request.uri LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: auth_failures_by_username
base_queries.nrql: FROM Transaction SELECT count(*) AS 'count' {{appNameWhereAnd}} name LIKE 'WebTransaction/%/POST /api/auth/login' AND auth.outcome = 'failure' FACET auth.username LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

deep_dive_queries.name: latency_by_txn_p95
deep_dive_queries.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95_ms' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} FACET name LIMIT 20 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

deep_dive_queries.name: latency_by_txn_avg
deep_dive_queries.nrql: SELECT average(duration) * 1000 AS 'avg_ms' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} FACET name LIMIT 20 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

deep_dive_queries.name: throughput_by_txn
deep_dive_queries.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'count' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} FACET name LIMIT 20 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

deep_dive_queries.name: errors_by_txn
deep_dive_queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'count' {{appNameClause}} FACET transactionName LIMIT 20 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago
